findings.text: the collapse is taken whenever two obligations share a kind and a next command and nothing requires the command to distinguish one more item from another, so two review-ready items -- complete review-role runs whose one remedy at reckon/crew/recovery.py:3544-3547 names no run -- render as one counted line that carries neither run id, contradicting the done_when's requirement that review-ready items keep one line each with their run id.

the collapsed line's age is compared only after AGE.sub replaces it on both sides, so the oldest-age figure is asserted for shape and not for value and a renderer taking the newest age instead of the oldest at reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:295 would pass the case unchanged.
